title: Nat Hutton Jr. Square / Hauser Boulevard / Obama Boulevard / Permanent Ceremonial Signage
motion: PUBLIC WORKS MOTION Nathanial “Nat” Hutton Jr. was born and raised in Topeka, Kansas. He moved to California to earn his Master of Business Administration from Stanford University befoie beginning his career with Security Pacific Bank, becoming Vice President for the Southern California region. Following his successful banking career, Hutton dedicated himself to serving his community. In his many years giving back to the community, Hutton worked with LA Family Housing, Executive Service Corps, Los Angeles Free Clinic, ON Egeneration, Sunair Children’s Foundation, and COPE Health Solutions Foundation. In addition to his partnerships with local community organizations, Hutton served on multiple committees and commissions concerned with addressing homelessness in the City. Hutton also oversaw an intergenerational tutoring program, working with local libiaries to pair senior citizens with students. Hutton passed away on April 24, 2026 at the age of 85. In recognition of Hutton’s legacy of service to his community and the City, it is appropriate that the City name the intei section of Hauser Boulevard and Obama Boulevard as “Nat Hutton Jr. Square. 1 THEREFORE MOVE that the intersection at Hauser Boulevard and Obama Boulevard be named as “Nat Hutton Jr. Square” and that the Department of Transportation be directed to erect permanent ceremonial sign(s) to this effect at this location. - PRESENTED BY: Xe— X/4) HEATHER HUTT Councilmember, 10th District SECONDED BY: majs (V v AUG 1 9 2026
